import sys
from collections import Counter

def can_form_circle(n, numbers):
    count = Counter(numbers)
    odd_count = sum(1 for v in count.values() if v % 2 != 0)
    return "YES" if odd_count == 0 else "NO"

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(input[0])
numbers = list(map(int, input[1:]))
print(can_form_circle(n, numbers))
